# Route × role matrix

<!-- GENERATED by apps/api/src/auth/route-access-matrix.spec.ts from the route decorators and
     ROLE_PERMISSIONS. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate from apps/api with:
     UPDATE_PERMISSION_MATRIX=1 pnpm exec jest src/auth/route-access-matrix.spec.ts -->

Every NestJS route, what it requires, and whether each caller may use it. A permission list is
an AND: the caller must hold every name. ✔ allowed · — refused · _via site_ reachable by an
anonymous browser only through the Next.js public site or sign-in page (NestJS itself is never
exposed to the internet). Open routes and in-handler checks are listed after the tables.

## Totals

170 routes. Manager 170, receptionist 106, visitor 16 (2 liveness probes directly, the rest via the site).

## Routes that require no permission

| Route | Kind | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /health` | public | Liveness probe; carries no data. |
| `GET /health/ready` | public | Readiness probe; carries no data. |
| `GET /health/db` | internal | Database reachability for the operator; the web tier does not front it. |
| `POST /auth/login` | internal | Where a session begins, so it cannot require one; the sign-in page. |
| `POST /auth/logout` | authenticated | Ends the caller's own session. |
| `GET /auth/session` | authenticated | The caller's own identity. |
| `POST /auth/password` | authenticated | Changes the caller's own password; requires the current one. |
| `GET /public/articles` | internal | Published articles only. |
| `GET /public/articles/:slug` | internal | One published article. |
| `GET /public/clinic-content` | internal | Published clinic copy. |
| `GET /public/clinic-profile` | internal | Address and contact details the site prints. |
| `GET /public/media/:renditionId` | internal | Bytes of a published attachment only, by opaque rendition id. |
| `POST /public/requests` | internal | The contact form; consent-gated and throttled, it creates an inbox row only. |
| `GET /public/services` | internal | Published services. |
| `GET /public/services/:slug` | internal | One published service. |
| `GET /public/sitemap` | internal | Published slugs for the sitemap. |
| `GET /public/spaces` | internal | Published clinic spaces. |
| `GET /public/team` | internal | Therapists whose profile a manager published. |
| `GET /public/team/:slug` | internal | One published therapist profile. |
| `GET /public/testimonials` | internal | Approved, published testimonials. |

## Authority checked inside a handler

| Permission | Where | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| appointment.override_availability | `apps/api/src/appointments/scheduling-rules.ts` | Booking or moving a session outside the therapist's hours also requires this name, with a recorded reason. |
| appointment.override_availability | `apps/api/src/appointments/appointment-series.service.ts` | The same override for a recurring series. |
| media.publish | `apps/api/src/media/media.service.ts` | Changing the description of a photograph that is already publicly served also requires this name. |
| media.read | `apps/api/src/media/media-preview.service.ts` | A staff preview of an unpublished photograph is limited to the owner types whose content the caller may read. |
| report.read_financial | `apps/api/src/reports/dashboard.service.ts` | Without it the dashboard shows the caller's own payment entries only, and no clinic-wide money. |
| therapist_share.void | `apps/api/src/settlement/share-rules/share-rules.service.ts` | Creating a share rule that supersedes another also requires the void name. |
